title: skillframe
summary: MSUI implements the current SkillFrame with law-owned list, collapse, scroll, divider, selected-detail and unlearn geometry while retaining the established character-page shell. The current 271x15 selected-skill bar, 281x32 border, description anchor and unlearn hit/visual seats replace the obsolete narrow detail layout. SkillFrameUiLaw now also owns the collapse-all button/icon anchor closure and exact GameFontHighlight label, scroll control UVs/thumb projection, measured collapse-label placement, popup backdrop insets, message placement, button geometry/UVs, main-panel/popup clip rectangles, and the unlearn tooltip's authored ANCHOR_RIGHT seat; GameLoop.SkillFrame contains no local Vector2 geometry or locally constructed clip Vector4. Staged capture remains rejected, ordinary capture observes authenticated player fields, and focused plus full clinical suites pass. Owner-run connected visual/sound/destructive-unlearn verification remains outstanding.

openItems.text: MSUI retained the older 211x15 selected-skill detail bar at (65.5,315.5), while current Benilla reuses the full 271x15 rank template at (38,325), with a 281x32 border, description at bar.BOTTOMLEFT (-2,-10), and unlearn button at border.RIGHT (-2,-1).
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: SkillFrameUiLaw owns the current detail bar, border, description, unlearn visual/hit seats, divider seats and centered StaticPopup layout. Both focused --skill-frame-only and the complete interface clinical suite pass.

openItems.text: The collapse-all control used GameFontNormalSmall and locally displaced hit/icon/text seats; current SkillFrame.xml inherits GameFontHighlight and anchors the button to the left cap RIGHT(-3,-3), its icon LEFT(+3,0), and text LEFT(+25,0).
openItems.resolution: SkillFrameUiLaw owns the exact button, icon, label font and measured label offset; the renderer and parity trace consume those values. Focused --skill-frame-only and the full desktop clinical suite pass without changing the protected Character shell.

openItems.text: The unlearn button tooltip used ImGui's implicit mouse placement instead of BenillaSkillUnlearnButton_OnEnter's ANCHOR_RIGHT owner seat.
openItems.resolution: SkillFrameUiLaw now maps the visual button's TOPRIGHT to the tooltip's BOTTOMLEFT, and the renderer applies that seat before opening the shared tooltip.
